about: Benchmark text for unicode-normalize: fragments picked by a 64-bit LCG (seed below) until the text is long enough. Rust (crates/kura-verify/src/bin/unicode-normalize.rs) and Python (reference.py) build the same text. Most fragments are already NFKC; the others contain full-width letters, half-width katakana, squared words, ligatures, decomposed accents, NBSP, ideographic spaces and invisible characters.
fragments: Rust parts for AI data pipelines are copied into your own project.
The tokenizer splits text into chunks before deduplication.
Benchmarks were measured on a laptop with the default settings.
Each part ships with differential tests against a reference implementation.
Invalid input is rejected with a clear error message.
